description: Polyphonic synth voice: an oscillator with selectable waveform and integer frequency ratios, an ADSR envelope, a VCA, and selectable external and feedback modulation types

params.text: Selects the oscillator waveform: sine, triangle, square or saw
Selects what the XMOD input does: AC or DC coupled through-zero linear FM, phase modulation, ring modulation, or amplitude modulation taken raw, rectified, or offset by 5V
Selects the type of modulation the feedback applies, with the same choices as the XMOD button: linear FM, phase, ring or amplitude modulation
Sets the curvature of the attack, decay and release stages, linear fully counter-clockwise and most curved fully clockwise; the stage times do not change with it
Sets how long the envelope takes to rise from 0% to 100%, 0.98ms to 11.3 seconds
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall from 100% to the sustain level, 0.98ms to 11.3 seconds
Sets the level the envelope holds while the gate stays high, 0% to 100%
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall from the sustain level to 0% once the gate goes low, 0.98ms to 11.3 seconds
Attenuates or inverts the SMOD input for that envelope stage, and the result is summed with the stage's knob
Sets the numerator of the frequency ratio, 1 to 64
Sets the denominator of the frequency ratio, 1 to 64
Detunes the oscillator away from the exact ratio, -100 cents to 100 cents
Attenuates or inverts the RMOD input for that ratio control, and the result is summed with its knob
Chooses how the internal envelope scales that control: off, the knob, the CV, or both, each of those also with the envelope inverted
Sets the level of the internal VCA, 0% to 100%, with a linear response by default
Sets the depth of the XMOD modulation, -100% to 100%
Sets the depth of the feedback modulation, -100% to 100%; the feedback is taken from the waveform before the level by default
Sets the oversampling applied against aliasing, off or x2 through x32, at x4 by default; only the XMOD input is upsampled
Attenuates or inverts the CV for that control, and the result is summed with its knob
Chooses what the SYNC/RTRG input does: hard sync the oscillator, retrigger the envelope and hard sync, or retrigger the envelope with no sync
Switches the ENV output between normal, rising from 0V during the attack, and inverted, resting at 10V and falling during the attack
Switches quantizing of the multiplier and divisor to whole numbers, on by default

inputs.text: One CV shared by the four envelope stages, each through its own attenuverter; a volt doubles or halves a stage time, or moves the sustain level by 10%
One CV shared by the multiplier, divisor and detune, each through its own attenuverter; 0.1V is one step of multiplier or divisor, and a volt is 10 cents of detune
A trigger here hard syncs the oscillator, retriggers the envelope, or does both, according to its mode button
CV into the VCA level at 10% per volt, summed with the LEVEL knob after its attenuverter
CV into the XMOD depth at 10% per volt, summed with the DEPTH knob after its attenuverter
CV into the feedback depth at 10% per volt, summed with the FDBK knob after its attenuverter
A high gate starts the envelope through attack, decay and sustain, and the release begins when the gate goes low
Pitch at a volt per octave for the oscillator before the frequency ratio is applied, with 0V giving C4 at 261.63Hz
The modulation signal for the oscillator, usually audio, with the type of modulation set by the XMOD button

menu: Exponential level response — switches the VCA level from a linear response to an exponential one
Post level feedback — takes the feedback from the waveform after the level rather than before it
Oversample filter quality — 10th order by default, with 8th order and a cheaper 6th order; 10th and 8th cut at 80% of Nyquist and 6th at 50%
